## Summary

**Repository:** usememos/memos (Go backend, `store`/memo model based note-taking app)

### 1. Where the derived metadata is computed

- **Core computation function:** `RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, memo *store.Memo, markdownService markdown.Service) error`
  `/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go` (lines 74-85)
  - Calls `markdownService.ExtractAll([]byte(memo.Content))` and assigns the result to `memo.Payload.Tags` and `memo.Payload.Property`.
- **Underlying extraction logic** lives in `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go`:
  - `ExtractAll` (lines 356-422) — single-pass AST walk producing tags, mentions, and properties (used by `RebuildMemoPayload`).
  - `ExtractTags` (lines 142-170) — pulls `#tag` nodes from the goldmark AST.
  - `ExtractProperties` (lines 192-241) — computes boolean content properties + title.
  - `GenerateSnippet` (lines 263-346) — builds a plain-text preview/snippet, truncated at a word boundary (`truncateAtWord`, lines 470-489), used for API responses (not persisted).
  - `extractHeadingText`/`extractTextFromNode` (lines 172-190) — extracts the H1 title text.

### 2. Triggers (when it runs)

Located in `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`:
- **On create** — `CreateMemo` (func starts line 70), calls `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, create, s.MarkdownService)` at **line 108**, right after content-length validation, before the memo is persisted.
- **On update** — `UpdateMemo` (func starts line 401), inside the `UpdateMask.Paths` loop, **only when `path == "content"`** (line 436), it calls `RebuildMemoPayload` at **line 447**, then sets `update.Content` / `update.Payload` for the store write. If content isn't in the update mask, the payload is left untouched (tags/properties aren't recomputed just from e.g. a visibility change).
- Snippets (`GenerateSnippet`) are computed **on-demand at read time**, not stored: `getMemoContentSnippet` in `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:83-86` (wraps `GenerateSnippet(content, 64)`), called from `memo_service_converter.go` (lines 76, 225, 248) when converting store memos to API responses, from `memo_relation_service.go:154,162`, and `user_service_notifications.go:323`.
- Note: there's also a batch `Runner` type (`memopayload.Runner`, `RunOnce` method, same file) intended to rebuild payloads for all memos in batches of 100 — useful for backfills/migrations — but it is **not currently wired up/scheduled** in `server/server.go` (only an unrelated `s3presignRunner` is scheduled there), so today it's effectively dead/unused code, only reachable if something calls `NewRunner(...).RunOnce(ctx)` directly.
- Mentions are also extracted via `ExtractAll` in `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_mention_helpers.go:32` (`resolveMentionTargets`), but that's for dispatching @mention notifications, not for persisted memo metadata.

### 3. Extracted/derived properties

Stored on `memo.Payload` (proto `MemoPayload`, defined in `/bench/repo/proto/store/memo.proto` lines 7-29):
- `tags []string` — all `#tag` occurrences (deduplicated, case preserved).
- `property.title` — text of the first H1 heading, only if it's the first block in the document.
- `property.has_link` — bool, any Markdown link present.
- `property.has_code` — bool, any code block/fenced code block/code span present.
- `property.has_task_list` — bool, any task checkbox present.
- `property.has_incomplete_tasks` — bool, any unchecked task checkbox present.
- `location` — set separately (not derived from content, comes from request payload in `memo_service.go:111-113`).

Additionally, computed at read-time (not persisted): a plain-text **snippet/preview** (max 64 chars, truncated at word boundary) via `GenerateSnippet`, and **mentions** (`@username`) via `ExtractAll`'s `Mentions` field (used transiently for notification dispatch, not stored on the memo).</result>
